title: Elodie and the Portrait
author: Noor Eriksen
blurb: Ivo Voss, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
